mapper.select: WITH ACTIVE_SUBSCRIBERS AS ( SELECT PLAN_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT UNIV_ID) AS SUBSCRIBER_COUNT FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ENDED_AT IS NULL AND UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PLAN_ID ) SELECT P.PLAN_ID, P.PLAN_NAME, P.PRICE, P.DESCRIPTION, P.BILLING_CYCLE, P.MAX_MEMBER_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATE_AT, P.DELETED_AT, NVL(A.SUBSCRIBER_COUNT, 0) AS SUBSCRIBER_COUNT FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P LEFT JOIN ACTIVE_SUBSCRIBERS A ON A.PLAN_ID = P.PLAN_ID ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PLAN_ID DESC

SELECT P.PLAN_ID, P.PLAN_NAME, P.PRICE, P.DESCRIPTION, P.BILLING_CYCLE, P.MAX_MEMBER_COUNT, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATE_AT, P.DELETED_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT S.UNIV_ID) FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S WHERE S.PLAN_ID = P.PLAN_ID AND S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND S.ENDED_AT IS NULL AND S.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL ) AS SUBSCRIBER_COUNT FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P WHERE P.PLAN_ID = #{planId}
SELECT NVL(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES WHERE STATUS = 'PAID' AND PAID_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND PAID_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS WHERE LOWER(PLAN_NAME) = LOWER(#{planName})
AND PLAN_ID != #{excludePlanId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS ( PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, PRICE, DESCRIPTION, BILLING_CYCLE, CREATED_AT, UPDATE_AT, DELETED_AT, MAX_MEMBER_COUNT ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{planName}, #{price}, #{description}, 'MONTHLY', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, NULL, #{maxMemberCount} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS SET PLAN_NAME = #{request.planName}, PRICE = #{request.price}, DESCRIPTION = #{request.description}, MAX_MEMBER_COUNT = #{request.maxMemberCount}, UPDATE_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS SET DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATE_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS SET DELETED_AT = NULL, UPDATE_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND DELETED_AT IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT H.HISTORY_ID, H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID, H.MEMBER_ID, H.BILLINGKEY_ID, B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_VALUE AS PORTONE_BILLING_KEY, B.STATUS AS BILLING_KEY_STATUS, H.MERCHANT_UID, H.PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID, H.AMOUNT, S.NEXT_BILLING_AT, COALESCE(H.PLAN_NAME, P.PLAN_NAME) AS PLAN_NAME FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H JOIN SUBSCRIPTIONS S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY B ON B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_ID = H.BILLINGKEY_ID WHERE S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND S.ENDED_AT IS NULL AND H.STATUS = 'READY' AND COALESCE(H.PLAN_NAME, P.PLAN_NAME) = #{planName} AND H.HISTORY_ID = ( SELECT MAX(R.HISTORY_ID) FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES R WHERE R.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AND R.STATUS = 'READY' ) ORDER BY H.HISTORY_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES SET MERCHANT_UID = #{merchantUid}, PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID = #{portoneScheduleId}, AMOUNT = #{amount}, PLAN_NAME = #{planName}, FAIL_REASON = NULL WHERE HISTORY_ID = #{historyId} AND STATUS = 'READY'
